title: Reverse Swing — EN/JA/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Reverse swing is for later in the day
When the ball is old and the pitch is tired
And the batsman thinks the hard part is over
That's when reverse swing says — actually

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
Chasは言った — リバーススウィングは忍耐の報酬だ [Chas said — reverse swing is the reward for patience]
ボールはその状態まで磨かれなければならない [The ball has to be worked to that condition]
片側が荒く、片側が滑らか [One side rough, one side smooth]
そして条件が整った時 [And when the conditions are right]
ボールはかつてやっていたことを思い出し、逆のことをする [The ball remembers what it used to do and does the opposite]

[Chorus — English]
Reverse swing says — you've been here before
Reverse swing says — except you haven't
Reverse swing says — you know what an old ball does
Reverse swing says — not this old ball

[Bridge — 中文]
逆摆是为了一天中晚些时候 [Reverse swing is for later in the day]
当球已经旧了，球场也累了 [When the ball is old and the pitch is tired]
击球手以为困难的部分已经过去了 [And the batsman thinks the hard part is over]
这就是逆摆说 — 其实不然 [That's when reverse swing says — actually]

[Verse 3 — English]
The late movement, the disbelief on the batsman's face
That's reverse swing saying hello

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
Reverse swing
リバーススウィング [Reverse swing]
逆摆 [Reverse swing]
That's my boy
